comment.body: Thanks for confirming in 2024 that desktop symptoms were still present after the 0.62.0 report. The issue does not establish whether they persist on current PowerToys or whether the install is machine-wide. Could you confirm the current version/install scope and which standard-user desktop action still fails (icon visibility, opening, or right-click)? This separates a current cross-profile issue from an old shell/icon-cache symptom; no generic logs are needed.
